newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem $75 mln debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem $75 mln debenture issue.

text.p: Freddie Mac said Tuesday that on April 21 it will redeem the entire $75 million principal amount of its 7.726 percent debenture issue.
The debentures were set to mature April 19, 2000 and have cusip number 3134005V1.
They will be redeemed at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount.
Payment of principal plus interest accrued to the redemption date will be made to shareholders of record as of the close of business on April 18, 1997, Freddie Mac said.
Freddie Mac is a corporation chartered by Congress that buys mortgages from lenders and packages them into securities for investors.
